findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Bốn tầng phản chiếu, một tiến trình tự chủ." → 4 lines (9 words, 69.1px); "Bắt đầu không phải bằng một câu trả lời. Bắt đầu" → 4 lines (19 words, 80px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 17 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Đời sống & Ranh giới" above "Định hướng & Giữ trục"; "Cảm xúc & Mô thức" above "Chữa lành & Tái cấu trúc"; "Nhận thức & Thấu hiểu" above "Tiếp cận ban đầu"; "Cơ thể & Hơi thở" above "Điều tiết thân & Năng lượng"; "Nếu bạn đang tìm hỗ trợ cho chính mình" above "Bắt đầu từ điều đang lặp lại."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 8 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): li 403px | li 403px | li 403px | article.reveal-child 509px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Little motion: 11 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
